violated_contract: Account deletion must finish when Stripe already has nothing left to cancel, and a billing failure must not fence an account whose Firebase Auth user and user document still exist.
canonical_prevention: Treat a missing or already-terminal subscription as billing success and continue the wipe, including billable app subscriptions. Park only a transient pre-Auth billing failure as billing_failed so access stays allowed, and have reconciliation finish historical already-gone billing_failed markers. Heartbeat a live wipe and reclaim a dead running worker after the run-lock TTL plus grace.
